parameter_status: ASSUMED_DEFAULT; implementation-specific values pending calibration against observed campus data, consistent with behavior_profiles.json/risk_config.json conventions. Not claimed as measured campus behavior.
road_context_note: This derived network carries no road-width/lane-class source data, so MAIN_ROAD vs NARROW_ROAD/ALLEY are not distinguishable among allowed_road edges; all such edges are classified CAMPUS_ROAD rather than guessed from road-name text. CROSSWALK_APPROACH is geometrically derived from the route's own upcoming-crosswalk lookahead, not fabricated geometry.
crosswalk_policy_note: ride_through keeps the scenario/free-flow speed as the crosswalk target (EXP5_CROSSWALK_RIDING); slow_riding caps it at crosswalk_policy_speed_kmh.slow_riding (EXP5_CROSSWALK_SLOW, also today's default so existing scenarios are unaffected); dismount forces dismount_walk_speed_mps for the crosswalk segment (EXP5_CROSSWALK_DISMOUNT). Values from EXP_set.pdf.
pedestrian_density_curve_note: Piecewise-linear [nearby_pedestrian_count, speed_factor] control points; interpolated, then held flat beyond the last point. Not a fitted statistical distribution.
